mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive 5-day S&P 500 returns as a trend signal.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals economic distress and weak labor market conditions, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative when UNRATE > 8.0% (p > 0.05 for negative returns) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Low FEDFUNDS (< 0.5%) combined with rising CPIAUCSL (> 0.3% monthly) indicates inflation risk and imminent monetary tightening, causing negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not negative when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 0.3% monthly (p > 0.05 for negative returns) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery regime (HOUST > 550.0 and RSAFS > 340000.0), rising housing starts and retail sales signal economic expansion, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive when HOUST > 550.0 and RSAFS > 340000.0 (p > 0.05 for positive returns) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST > 550.0) indicate improving economic conditions and consumer confidence, producing positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as a trend signal.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST > 550.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 500.0 signal housing market contraction and economic weakness, causing negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative when HOUST < 500.0 (p > 0.05 for negative returns) or Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS > 132000.0) combined with falling unemployment (UNRATE < 8.5%) signals labor market strengthening, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive when PAYEMS > 132000.0 and UNRATE < 8.5% (p > 0.05 for positive returns) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 215.0 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), central bank tightening causes negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not negative when CPIAUCSL > 215.0 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5% (p > 0.05 for negative returns) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.
